title: Add single-home Compose layout

context.summary: Move Docker Compose runtime state into a single Mindory-owned home directory.
context.background: The installer plan requires config, data, logs, backups and release assets to live under MINDORY_HOME so install, update and uninstall flows can operate on one root.

in: Replace Mindory runtime named volumes in docker-compose.yml with bind mounts under MINDORY_HOME.
Add host paths for config, logs, backups, install/release state and data directories.
Add a LibreFS local S3-compatible Compose profile placeholder with data mounted under MINDORY_HOME.
Update Compose validation to enforce the single-home layout.
Update deployment/configuration documentation for the new host directory contract.
out: S3 adapter changes beyond using existing S3-compatible env variables.

acceptance_criteria: docker-compose.yml no longer uses named Mindory runtime volumes for Postgres, Redis or object storage.
Postgres, Redis, local object storage and optional service data are bind-mounted below MINDORY_HOME.
Compose includes a LibreFS local S3-compatible profile with data under MINDORY_HOME.
Docs explain the MINDORY_HOME directory layout and reset implications.
Compose validation checks the single-home bind mount contract.

manual_checks: Confirm no installer wizard or rollback code is included.

risks: Compose interpolation for HOME defaults must remain portable enough for local development.
Reset scripts should avoid deleting arbitrary user paths.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
